description: Ground-truth Q&A over the Corvanta sample corpus (policies + FY2025 financial PDF). Includes answerable, out-of-domain (must refuse) and adversarial (must block) cases.

cases.question: What was Corvanta's total revenue for FY2025?
cases.ground_truth: Total revenue for FY2025 was $4.82 billion, an increase of 11.3 percent from $4.33 billion in FY2024.

cases.question: What were the diluted earnings per share and net income in FY2025?
cases.ground_truth: Net income was $684 million and diluted earnings per share were $3.42.

cases.question: How much revenue did the Cloud Services segment generate and how fast did it grow?
cases.ground_truth: Cloud Services revenue was $2.31 billion, an increase of 19.7 percent year over year.

cases.question: What was the free cash flow and capital expenditures in FY2025?
cases.ground_truth: Free cash flow was $968 million and capital expenditures were $242 million.

cases.question: What is the FY2026 revenue outlook guidance?
cases.ground_truth: For FY2026 Corvanta expects total revenue between $5.25 billion and $5.35 billion.

cases.question: What percentage of revenue came from North America, EMEA and APAC?
cases.ground_truth: North America contributed 61 percent of revenue, EMEA 27 percent and APAC 12 percent.

cases.question: What quarterly dividend did the Board declare and how much stock was repurchased?
cases.ground_truth: Corvanta repurchased $400 million of its common stock and the Board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share.

cases.question: What is the hotel cap per night in Tier 1 cities?
cases.ground_truth: Hotel stays are capped at $275 per night in Tier 1 cities (New York, San Francisco, London and Tokyo).

cases.question: What is the meal per diem for domestic and international travel?
cases.ground_truth: The meal per diem is $85 per day for domestic travel and $110 per day for international travel.

cases.question: Who must approve business class flights?
cases.ground_truth: Business class requires written approval from a Senior Vice President before booking.

cases.question: Within how many days must expense reports be submitted in Concur?
cases.ground_truth: Expense reports must be submitted in Concur within 30 days of the end of the trip; reports submitted more than 60 days after the trip are not reimbursed without a CFO exception.

cases.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for using a personal vehicle?
cases.ground_truth: Personal vehicle mileage is reimbursed at $0.70 per mile.

cases.question: Above what amount are itemized receipts required for a single expense?
cases.ground_truth: Itemized receipts are required for any single expense over $25.

cases.question: What is the minimum password length?
cases.ground_truth: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

cases.question: How quickly must a suspected security incident be reported to the Security Operations Center?
cases.ground_truth: Suspected security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Center within 1 hour of discovery.

cases.question: Can Restricted or Confidential data be entered into public generative AI tools?
cases.ground_truth: No. Restricted and Confidential data must never be entered into public generative AI tools; only approved enterprise AI tools such as Corvanta Copilot may be used.

cases.question: How long are security logs retained?
cases.ground_truth: Security logs are retained for 400 days.

cases.question: How many days per week are hybrid employees expected to work from the office?
cases.ground_truth: Hybrid employees are expected to work from the office 3 days per week, with Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday as anchor days.

cases.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave do primary caregivers receive?
cases.ground_truth: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

cases.question: How many days of PTO do employees with 3 to 5 years of service accrue?
cases.ground_truth: Employees with 3 to 5 years of service accrue 20 days of PTO per year.

cases.question: What is the home office stipend and monthly internet allowance?
cases.ground_truth: Eligible employees receive a one-time home office stipend of $500 and a monthly internet allowance of $50.
